component.name: WebBrowser

Label.text: OK: Play/Pause | UP/DOWN: Next/Prev Channel | LEFT: Channel List | BACK: Exit

component.script:
function init() m.videoPlayer = m.top.findNode("videoPlayer") m.urlDisplay = m.top.findNode("urlDisplay") m.contentLabel = m.top.findNode("contentLabel") m.channelList = m.top.findNode("channelList") m.channels = [] m.currentChannelIndex = 0 m.showChannels = false m.videoPlayer.observeField("state", m.port) end function
function loadChannels(channels as Object) as void m.channels = channels updateChannelList() end function
function playChannel(index as Integer) as void if index >= 0 and index < m.channels.count() m.currentChannelIndex = index channel = m.channels[index] m.urlDisplay.text = channel.title playVideo(channel.url, channel.title) end if end function
function playVideo(url as String, title as String) as void m.videoPlayer.visible = true m.contentLabel.visible = false m.channelList.visible = false
content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = url content.title = title content.streamFormat = "auto"
m.videoPlayer.content = content m.videoPlayer.control = "play" m.videoPlayer.setFocus(true) end function
function updateChannelList() as void parentNode = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each channel in m.channels node = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") node.title = channel.title node.description = channel.url parentNode.appendChild(node) end for m.channelList.content = parentNode end function
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
if key = "left" m.showChannels = not m.showChannels m.channelList.visible = m.showChannels if m.showChannels and m.channels.count() > 0 m.channelList.setFocus(true) else m.videoPlayer.setFocus(true) end if return true
else if key = "up" if m.showChannels if m.channelList.hasFocus() m.channelList.moveUp() end if else if m.currentChannelIndex > 0 playChannel(m.currentChannelIndex - 1) end if end if return true
else if key = "down" if m.showChannels if m.channelList.hasFocus() m.channelList.moveDown() end if else if m.currentChannelIndex < m.channels.count() - 1 playChannel(m.currentChannelIndex + 1) end if end if return true
else if key = "OK" if m.channelList.visible and m.channelList.hasFocus() focusedItem = m.channelList.itemFocused playChannel(focusedItem) m.showChannels = false m.channelList.visible = false m.videoPlayer.setFocus(true) return true else if m.videoPlayer.visible if m.videoPlayer.paused m.videoPlayer.control = "play" else m.videoPlayer.control = "pause" end if return true end if end if
return false end function
